title: Monterey Bay Famous Dog Friendly Electric Bike and Sidecar Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Our minimum number of travelers to conduct a tour is 2 riders handling their own e-bikes and one dog. Please contact our shop to share your party information with us!
We have 2 sizes of sidecars for the same cost. They fit 1-2 dogs of various weights and family/friend dynamics. Please tell us what you'd like!
We encourage you to exercise your dog(s) the morning before the tour that will help them reduce stress, be mellow and calm enough to sit for up to two hours, and to eliminate.

If you determine within 24 hours to tour time while you are still at the shop that your dog that this experience is not for you or your dog, you can get store credit for tours, rental and shop merchandise. However, once you depart for the tour and decide anytime during the tour that you need to bail, we will not refund or credit your account.
Sidecars fit dogs up to 100lbs combined weight or single dog weight. You must be able to lift your dog(s) in and out of the sidecars.

Dogs' health and needs come first on this tour. As opportunity and needs allow, we will stop for no additional charge for potty and running breaks, water breaks, or cutting the tour short if you feel that's best.

This experience is suitable for dogs with a demeanor that enjoys movement, wind in their face, and adventures. It has proven not enjoyable by dogs with separation anxiety from the rider not handling the side car or dogs afraid of speed, bumps, bikes or being latched down.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You will coast from our downtown Carmel-By-The-Sea bike shop directly down to Carmel Beach to romp on the beach with your furry friend! Then ride along the Carmel coastline via Scenic Drive. You’ll sniff out landmarks like the Frank Lloyd Wright house, Tor House, Butterfly House, Carmel River State Beach, Clint Eastwood’s Mission Ranch, the Carmel Mission and Mission Trail Park, the original fairy-tale homes, and maybe Stillwater Cove Beach inside Pebble Beach Resort, with opportunities at every turn for sniffing.

You will ride our premium e-bikes, and your dog will be in our custom handmade sidecars. These powerful, pedal-assisted electric bikes will allow us to cover a lot of ground. The e-bikes with sidecars also have throttles. We have two different-sized side car(s). Please tell us pet weight, breed, name, and which height rider might handle the side car. If you have more than one dog, specify if you think they’d prefer to be together in one sidecar or if you’d like two sidecars.
